statements.status_notes: Per upstream, this Rego path-injection issue only affects OPA when it is deployed as a standalone server exposing the HTTP Data API; deployments that embed OPA as a Go library are not impacted. The Snyk CLI embeds OPA as a library for IaC evaluation and never starts the OPA server, so the vulnerable server Data API code path is not reachable in this image.
